lines.en: label utamaid1:
scene utafirstmaidcafe1
I walk into the maid cafe to find it pretty much deserted- which I guess makes sense considering that they close in around an hour.
There’s a little bell near where you walk in that I guess they want you to ring in the event of something like this happening, but...
I am a man.
I shall ring no bell.
I will remain standing right here until a maid emerges from the kitchen and awkwardly discovers that there is someone waiting to be taken advantage of.
: Uta-chan’s maid-senses are tingling! Someone has arrived!
That someone is me.
She could probably sense my unrivaled love for her.
scene utafirstmaidcafe2
: Ah! Sen- Master! You came to visit me!
: Woah. Did you almost break character just now?
: Uta-chan is the perfect maid who never breaks character and makes all of her masters leave with full hearts and full tummies!
: And, in return, she gets to leave with a full coinpurse!
: That last part didn’t seem like a very maid-like thing to say.
scene utafirstmaidcafe3
: Sorry, Master. I just feel so comfortable around you that I guess I let a little bit of my true self slip.
: Teehee~
: God, you’re good at this.
scene utafirstmaidcafe4
: I like taking care of people.
: I talked about it in class but I was looking after my grandpa before coming here.
: Most people would probably get bothered by something like that after a while but I thought it was kinda fun!
: Like taking care of a baby except the baby is like four times your age and smokes cigarettes.
: Ahh, yes. I can totally see the correlation.
scene utafirstmaidcafe5
: Good! Cause today, since nobody else is around, Master gets Uta-chan all to himself!
: I’ll be sure to make you even happier than I used to make grandpa before the cancer spread.
She doesn’t even realize how dark that was, does she?
: You sure that’s okay? I feel kind of bad for showing up so late in hindsight- like you’re supposed to be cleaning right now or something.
: Of course it’s okay! I’m not really supposed to be spending so much time in the back anyway.
: I need a stepping stool to reach most of the stuff back there and it’s led to a few more broken glasses and dishes than I’d like to admit.
: But it’s no fun talking about things like that when you’re here to unwind! Come take a load off, Master! I’ll sit you down at my favorite table!
scene black
Uta breaks the no-contact policy she informed me of the first time I came here and grabs my wrist, pulling me to a table near the window.
She doesn’t sit down beside me. But she does slam her hands down onto the table like some sort of detective interrogating a murder suspect.
scene utafirstmaidcafe6
: So, Master...how can I make your dreams come true today?
: You can start by calling your parents.
: Sorry, Master. I can’t talk about things that frisky while I’m on the clock.
: Unfortunately, Uta-chan will have to reject you once again.
: But if there is anything slightly more legal that you’re interested in, all you need to do is let me know!
: I can just wait an hour or two until you’re off the clock. It’s fine.
: Such determination. You’re really cute when you set your sights on something, Master!
: I’m not weirded out at all!
: Saying that makes me feel like you are...
: Hey, know what’s even better than all of those dirty thoughts you’re having right now, Master?
: ...Nothing?
: A nice...hot...plate of dinner!
: That’s not really better but I guess I’ll have to settle for it.
scene utafirstmaidcafe7
: Do you need a menu? Or do you want me to just have them make you something I know you’ll fall in love with?
: Besides me, I mean~
: Uta, I want you to know that you make it very hard to not flirt with you when you say things like that.
: Of course. That’s the whole point of places like this, silly.
: I say things to make you feel good and, in return, you spend all of your money on little-ole Uta-chan so she can buy more socks and underwear.
: And I’m guessing you tacked underwear onto the end of that as another part of the maid-strategy?
: It worked, right? Are you thinking about my panties now?
: It makes you want to spend more money on me, right?
I look down at the table to find that I’ve already begun subconsciously sliding my wallet toward Uta.
: When did this even happen?
: You reached into your pocket the second I said underwear.
: Even girls do that sometimes. It’s kinda crazy how well it works.
: I guess I’m pretty good at this, huh?
: Yes. You’re going to bankrupt me one day.
scene utafirstmaidcafe8
: Uta-chan can’t help it if Master lets his mind wander. But as long as he’s happy and keeps his hands to himself, he can do whatever he likes.
: And, in the meantime, I’ll go put your order in! Try not to stare at my butt as I walk away, okay?
: My skirt’s a little short today so I’m kinda worried you might accidentally catch a peek~
: Are you actually a genius, Uta?
scene utafirstmaidcafe9
: Just a maid~ We’re all like this.
: Ami will be exactly like me soon. Just you watch.
scene utafirstmaidcafe10
Uta walks away and I realize that her skirt isn’t any shorter than normal. I know this for sure because I always stare at her as she walks away.
I’ve been deceived.
And also, now I have to worry that Ami will be using these same tricks on me soon.
This is no haven for degenerates. It’s a prison.
It sucks us in under the false pretenses of cute girls who will unconditionally care about us-
When in all actuality, it’s just a cash-vacuum that they use and abuse until they can line their pockets with our hard-earned money.
I shall not be defeated by a place like this.
I am a man.
I didn’t even ring the bell.
All I have to do is hold out a little while longer...
scene black
scene utafirstmaidcafe11
Uta comes back several minutes later with a plate of omurice, but instead of blessing it with the ritualistic flavor-beam, she sits across from me and presses her fingers together.
This time it feels less like the work of a criminal-investigator and more like some sort of...seductive older woman.
: You know, Master. It just occurred to me while I was in the kitchen that I can really take advantage of you if I want.
: Have you not already been doing that?
: Of course not. Uta-chan’s been nothing but affectionate and attentive toward you.
: She even went as far as infusing all of the love in her little heart into this omelette.
: If you’re looking for more money, I don’t know what else I’d even be able to give-
scene utafirstmaidcafe12
: Calm down. I’m not actually going to do anything.
: You say that, but I have a hard time believing this isn’t part of your scheme as well.
scene utafirstmaidcafe13
: Heheh~ It’s not. Really.
: I was just thinking that it’s a little risky for someone working in public education to even come to a maid cafe this close to the[school] in the first place.
: The only reason I got a job here instead of somewhere closer to my old[school] was that I was worried about being caught.
: But here you are, an actual teacher, throwing all of his money at Uta-chan and thinking about her underwear and stuff.
scene utafirstmaidcafe14
: Aren’t you worried about getting caught?
: Like, what if a girl from a different class saw you here and ratted you out to one of the other teachers or something?
: Well...that would probably make me look bad. But I think they’d also be revealing that they have a job in the process, so they’d be effectively ratting themselves out as well.
scene utafirstmaidcafe15
: Wait, are we not allowed to have jobs at this[school]?
: My other one was fine with them as long as they were part-time and we kept our grades up.
: Oh, wait! You’re actually here to blackmail Uta-chan, aren’t you?!
: You want to get freaky with her so badly that you’re abusing your power because you know you can get her on her back-foot!
: Or even worse- her back!
: ...While the desire to “get freaky with you” may almost certainly be true-
: Almost?! Uta-chan’s not even a definite candidate in her ultimate form?!
: ...I have no intention of blackmailing you.
: You keep my presence here a secret and I’ll keep yours a secret in return.
scene utafirstmaidcafe16
: Ah! Back-scratching! It’s finally shown up!
: That’s right. We’re both breaking rules by being here, so the least we can do is help each other continue to break them instead of abiding by them.
: I agree. Rules are dumb. Like, there’s that one rule at the mall where you can’t even bring more than like five things into the dressing room at once.
: But what if I wanna try on more than five things? You know?
: And also, what’s the deal with not being able to use your cell-phone on planes? I hate rules.
: None of that really has anything to do with what I was trying to say, but I feel you.
scene utafirstmaidcafe17
: Whaaaat? You want to feel me? Master! Keep your voice down.
: You know, that’s not what I meant, but it’s true so there’s no sense in denying it.
: I would like to “feel” you immediately, if at all possible.
scene utafirstmaidcafe18
: Wait, no. It feels kinda weird if you just go along with it like that.
: We’re supposed to keep going back and forth for a little while and then I’m supposed to shoot you down and apologize.
: You’re breakin’ out of the pattern here. Next thing I know, you’re going to be telling me you weren’t even staring at my butt as I walked away.
: Oh, I can guarantee that I was doing just that.
: Your skirt is also the same size as always.
scene utafirstmaidcafe19
: Stooooooooop right there, Master!
: As flattered as I am to hear that you think I’m cute enough to stare at me as I walk away, I’m afraid that I can’t let things go any further.
: So I am sorry but, once again, I must reject you. Please do not hold this against me or take it out on my report card.
: I am willing to do several special things to increase my grades after hours but probably not the things you want me to do.
: What does that even mean? What sort of things would you do to increase your grades?
: I can’t tell you that or you’ll lower them on purpose. Please forget I said anything and enjoy your omurice.
: It was made with love. Lots of love. All of the love in my tiny body.
scene utafirstmaidcafe20
: Heheh~
: Talking to you is fun.
: And I’m not just saying that as Uta-chan.
: Did you ever get annoyed with me those first few days I transferred in? How I stuck to your side the whole time?
: Annoyed? Not really.
: You talk a lot but it’s not like you do anything that actually disrupts my day.
: Well, that’s good. I’m glad I asked.
scene utafirstmaidcafe14
: Question, and you can say no if it makes you feel weird, but did you maybe want to give me a ride back to the dorm after this?
: I’m still new-ish to the area and not totally comfortable going alone yet.
: Io was gonna come meet me but I’m pretty sure she fell asleep or something.
: I don't have a car, so I can't give you a ride. But we can walk back if you'd like.
scene utafirstmaidcafe15
: An adult without a car?!
: This is the city. We don’t really need cars with all the public transportation here.
: Oh right. I’m not in the country anymore.
: Well then, did you want to walk back with me instead?
: As long as I have some big guy like you next to me, I’ll feel a lot safer.
: That crazy brawl with Yumi really gave me a wake-up call about how weak I am.
: That crazy brawl was a two-second arm-wrestle, but sure. I’ll walk back with you.
scene utafirstmaidcafe16
: Yay!
: But remember, no holding my hand unless I ask you to.
: Right. Keep my hands in the vehicle at all times. You’ve said that before.
: Yes. Uta-chan is not for sale.
: Unless you hire me to come clean your room or your house or something. I’d probably do that for you.
: Ami normally handles all of that, but I’ll let you know if she just suddenly...stops for some reason.
: Works for me!
: Now- dig in, Master! Your food’s probably cold by now!
scene black
I hang around the cafe for the next hour until it’s time for Uta to leave.
The two of us walk back together and she tells me a little bit more about what life in Nara was like.
Apparently, before she came here to take care of her grandfather, she also did all of the cooking and cleaning around the house.
She seems a bit worried about how they’re all getting on without her over there, but it doesn’t seem to break her spirit at all.
Eventually, we make it back to the dorm and she trots up the stairs, thanking me again for bringing her back.
Then, the next thing I know, I’m headed back home to a different maid.
Life sure has gotten interesting lately.
